title: Vaporesso Xros 4 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso XROS 4 Kit stands at the peak of pod system innovation, featuring a durable all-aluminium alloy unibody and equipped with a long-lasting 1000mAh internal battery. This kit embodies efficiency and elegance and is designed to cater to a broad spectrum of vaping preferences from tight MTL (mouth-to-lung) draws to satisfying RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) hits. At the heart of the XROS 4 lies the revolutionary Corex 2.0 pod technology, exclusive to the 0.6ohm and 0.8ohm pods in the Vaporesso pod family. By optimizing mesh grid size and utilizing upgraded cotton, the COREX 2.0 ensures rapid heating for an explosion of flavour, extended coil lifespan, and effective prevention against burnt tastes. Adjusting airflow is effortlessly precise, thanks to a thoughtfully placed sliding back button, allowing you to customize your draw resistance with ease. Further personalization is made possible with three output modes, easily navigated through the device's intuitive interface, ensuring every vape session is tailored to your liking. Charging is a breeze with fast 2A USB-C charging , significantly reducing wait times and enhancing your vaping experience with less downtime. Additionally, the XROS 4's compatibility with the entire XROS pod series, including the latest 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω options, ensures unprecedented versatility and convenience, complemented by a top-filling system and the leak-resistant SSS technology for hassle-free refills and maintenance. Embrace the Vaporesso XROS 4 Kit for an exquisite blend of form, function, and flavour, solidifying its place as an essential companion for discerning vapers seeking innovation, performance and style. Kits Update: All Kits now come with 0.6ohm & 0.8ohm Corex 2.0 pods. We recommend pairing the included pods with the following E-Liquid RDL Xros Series 0.6ohm Mesh Pod with Nic Salts or 50/50 E-Liquids MTL Xros Series 0.8ohm Mesh Pod with 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
